record.note: Unresolved incident: Binance said its hot wallets were compromised at about 20:05 UTC on Oct 29, with about $6.3B of token assets taken through unauthorized withdrawals; it first pointed to a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop but later found additional points of breach, and says it has found no evidence that wallet private keys leaked. About $3B has been frozen on-chain, Binance has set aside more than $6.34B to cover all losses (SAFU fund and company funds), withdrawals stay paused with a phased restart targeted, deposits work, and a Proof of Reserves update (by Nov 2) and a post-mortem are promised.
